memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, teaches college classes, uses public transport.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal).
falls: no falls in past 12 months, gait normal, TUG 9 seconds.
medicines: 6 regular (levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD, cetirizine 10 mg HS, fluticasone nasal spray OD, montelukast 10 mg HS, propranolol 40 mg OD). Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria.
mood: reports occasional low mood, denies depression.
carers: spouse (Ravi), supportive.
goal: "I want to stay seizure‑free and keep teaching without migraine days."
